name: Quantile normalise (percentile threshold family)
plain: A percentile threshold per sample or globally, then one of many strategies: clamp, tanh, sigmoid, wave functions, scale down. Exposed as a latent operation, so it can run on the guidance delta through a CFG hook. This is the closest pack-side form of dynamic thresholding for latents in this scan; proper dynamic thresholding nodes sit in the guidance family.
math:
nq=quantile(|x|, q, flattened or dim)·nq_fac+eps
clamp: x.clamp(−nq,nq); tanh: tanh(x)·|nq|; tanh_outliers: apply only where |x|>nq; others per table
negative q: uses proxy sign(x)(max|x|−|x|)
pow_fac from arg list (default 0.5), body past line 427 not read

props.params: quantile=0.75, dim=1, flatten=True, nq_fac=1, pow_fac=.5, strategy=clamp
